author: Sevoss
quote: GTA 6 completely missed the characteristics this game should have. We all loved Rockstar games because of the foul languages, no restrictions and gangster feeling, this one doesnt give the South Park vibes. The maincharacter Jason dont have a unique personality and is just boring. The story is corporate HR approved slop. Restrictions for a certain kind of people, no gambling, no hookers, almost no foul language, no plane crashes into buildings etc... The heists get quite boring because its literally almost the same, the story is not exiting enough. The result of DEI hires and the wrong people in charge. Stakeholders wanted to do money by making the game for everyone but they completely missed the point of a real GTA. Beside all the Bugs, other things need to be fixed very quickly.  Overall very dissapointed and angry that i waited so long for this nonsense. The people dont want to play a perfect man (who never would be a gangster) with the single point to make a cheating wife happy. Rockstar need to fix alot in this one!
